facts: After finishing race 4 HUN 37 was inspected by the technical committee.
The technical committee found HUN 37 not compliant with C5.1.4.
HUN 37 accepted a 10% as per the SI 15.6 and filled out a penalty report.
The TC asked to withdraw the protest.
conclusions: There is no reason to refuse the request to withdraw the protest.
decision: The protest committee allows the protest to be withdrawn.
